strategyPolicy.objective: Reconstruct the earliest weekly checkpoint at which the unchanged causal/exposure/quality/expectation/timing discipline could produce a stock selection.
strategyPolicy.weeklyCheckpoint: Friday after market close; next executable trading session is the entry anchor.
strategyPolicy.duplicateRule: Same economic cluster + same ticker inside the prior 60-trading-day base horizon is continuation, not a new independent opportunity.
strategyPolicy.outcomeRule: 60 trading-day net return and excess versus CSI300; positive > 0 is a hit.
strategyPolicy.caution: This is not a clean blind holdout because 2026 quarterly replays and some later history are already known. Exact early-entry future-price paths are not used in the decisions below.

eventDecisions.reason: The Jan-5 signal was a continuation of an already-visible Q4 memory upcycle; 603986/300223 had already materially outperformed on 20d/60d price measures and there was not yet a sufficiently incremental reset to justify a new weekly selection.

eventDecisions.name: 亿纬锂能
eventDecisions.reason: Storage demand/utilization was independently improving while the stock basket was de-rated; EVE had direct storage shipment growth and improving cash flow, but lithium input volatility and margin quality kept it Research only.
Two first-party global suppliers confirmed demand, but this remained a continuation without a fresh A-share company-specific edge.
Record futures pricing lacked confirming physical-demand evidence and was retained as a negative-control event.

eventDecisions.name: 兆易创新
eventDecisions.reason: The Feb-2 price forecast was a large incremental magnitude reset versus Jan-5, while 603986 already had realized Q3 revenue/profit acceleration and direct memory exposure. Strong prior price absorption blocks Primary but not a Research selection.
The bottleneck was real but the frozen evidence did not establish a clean A-share beneficiary rather than downstream customers harmed by delay and higher CPU cost.
Scarcity and export-control enforcement had opposite incidence across upstream and downstream; no company-level pass-through edge was verified.

eventDecisions.name: 中远海能
eventDecisions.reason: The physical freight-rate shock had a direct tanker earnings expression and prior public evidence established rate sensitivity. However the basket was already extremely strong, so the signal remains Research rather than Primary.
Macro equipment/capex growth was too broad for a narrow company-level causal and expectation gap.
The global nitrogen shock was real, but no A-share producer had a frozen company-specific feedstock/export-policy earnings bridge clean enough for selection.

eventDecisions.name: 宁德时代
eventDecisions.reason: CATL Q1 delivered a realized earnings surprise with resilient profitability and direct ESS volume exposure; the weekly price basket was neutral rather than broadly over-absorbed. This preserves the original Q2 strategy's Primary classification.

eventDecisions.name: 三环集团
eventDecisions.reason: Q1 profit/mix evidence was strong and AI-linked, but valuation/price absorption was already high enough to block Primary.
Broad demand softness is a contradiction filter, not a standalone beneficiary thesis.
Broad input inflation does not identify who captures margin and therefore fails company mapping.

eventDecisions.name: 兆易创新
eventDecisions.reason: This is a new re-underwrite after the earlier Q1 decision horizon: Q1 earnings and forecasts reset sharply, while the May-29 structural-shortage evidence reconfirmed the cycle. Price absorption and valuation still block Primary.
Policy response without realized company economics is insufficient.
